turns.customer: I've used the Glowworm headlamp from order #1050 on a few night hikes, and now it won't turn on, even with new batteries. Can I return it?
turns.reply: Since the headlamp stopped working after you used it, it isn't eligible for a standard return, as it falls outside our return policy for used items. However, since it may be covered by the 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects, I've escalated this to our team (Ticket ESC-45). A human support agent will follow up by email, usually within one business day. Thanks for understanding.
